blocks.text: How Jesus fails to be the Messiah
Chazon/Revelation 19:10

blocks.html: “For it is the Spirit of prophecy who bears testimony to Yahushua.”
blocks.text: “For it is the Spirit of prophecy who bears testimony to Yahushua.”

blocks.html: The Messiah is defined by The Torah and the Prophets of יהוה. Yahushua fulfillled in great detail over 300 Tanach [Old Testament] prophecies concerning the Messiah. BUT some will say so did “Jesus”! This is because the “false image Jesus” is built on the life of the true Messiah Yahushua. The TRUE Messiah must fulfill EVERY prophecy spoken in The Torah/Prophets not just 90% of them. If he fails in even 1, he is not The Messiah! So, let's take a critical look at the difference between Jesus and Yahushua.

blocks.html: 1. Jesus H. Christ did not come in the name of יהוה. This image and name is built upon 3 pagan gods Hesus, Horus, and Krishna. Yahushua came in the proper name of “יהוה is our Savoir”.

blocks.html: We see the Greek letters such as IC and XC (which is XS today) used as symbols for ‘Jesus Christ’ in painted mosaics the world over clearly identifying Jesus Christ as the beast John saw in Chazon/Revelation.
blocks.text: We see the Greek letters such as IC and XC (which is XS today) used as symbols for ‘Jesus Christ’ in painted mosaics the world over clearly identifying Jesus Christ as the beast John saw in Chazon/Revelation.

blocks.html: “IC XC” as written in the Hellenistic period is a Christogram, a monogram of “Jesus Christ”. When Jesus Christ is written in Greek it looks like this: ΙΗΣΟΥΣ ΧΡΙΣΤΟΣ. If we take the first and last letters of ΙΗΣΟΥΣ (“Jesus”) and ΧΡΙΣΤΟΣ (“Christ”) we are left with: ΙΣ ΧΣ. Today that would read IS XS.
blocks.text: “IC XC” as written in the Hellenistic period is a Christogram, a monogram of “Jesus Christ”. When Jesus Christ is written in Greek it looks like this: ΙΗΣΟΥΣ ΧΡΙΣΤΟΣ. If we take the first and last letters of ΙΗΣΟΥΣ (“Jesus”) and ΧΡΙΣΤΟΣ (“Christ”) we are left with: ΙΣ ΧΣ. Today that would read IS XS.

blocks.html: These mosaics of Jesus Christ have a serpent symbol above the IC XC (which today would be IS XS). If you move that serpent symbol into the monogram above it, you have the exact symbol Yochanan/John wrote in Chazon/Revelation 13:18. Remember the Greek letter Sigma Σ at the time this mosaic was painted was transliterated as a C. Today the Sigma is transliterated as an S.
